target.label: Self-reported Lyme disease diagnosis
target.definition: Participant reports having been told by a clinician that they have Lyme disease (All of Us Personal and Family Health History survey)
target.population: Adults with an EHR visit in the past year and no Lyme disease code (ICD-10-CM A69.2)

index_event.rule: day 0 is the date the chart is scored; all windows look back from it

exclusion.reason: a Lyme disease diagnosis is already recorded

history_requirement.reason: no encounters in the past year (insufficient history)

features.label: Fatigue or malaise coded in the past year
Palpitations, POTS, orthostatic hypotension, or dysautonomia
Sore throat or enlarged lymph nodes
6+ outpatient visits in the past year
12+ outpatient visits in the past year
Emergency visit in the past year
Hospital stay in the past 5 years

provenance.data: NIH All of Us Research Program, Registered Tier Dataset v9 (CDR R2025Q4R6)
provenance.method: Naive Bayes with empirical-Bayes shrinkage, fit outside the Researcher Workbench from dissemination-compliant summary counts (every released cell above 20, rounded up to 10); labels are survey self-reports, so the model learns from patients whose diagnosis was never coded

statement: Research decision support. Surfaces chart patterns for clinician review. Not a diagnosis.
